purpose: Require computed path-set evidence before an MLB starter DFS producer can be considered ready.
freeze_requirements: derive thresholds from declared market-blind strictly-prior historical starter/game paths
pin source bytes and source hashes
declare training/reference window before generator evaluation
freeze all thresholds before any producer is evaluated
notes: Per-path producer booleans cannot satisfy this policy.
A single complete-game path is legal; a path distribution that never exercises the hook/bullpen/final-state dynamics is not.
No numeric empirical band is invented by this preregistration. Production validation remains blocked until the policy is frozen.
